learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding: Knowledge and understanding of mathematics and other basic sciences inherent to their engineering specialty, at a level that allows them to acquire the rest of the degree's competencies.

Engineering projects: Ability to plan, design and develop complex products (parts, components, finished products, etc.), processes and systems of their specialty, that meet the established requirements, including being aware of social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial aspects; as well as selecting and applying appropriate project methods.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment and tools, engineering technology and processes, and their limitations in their specialty.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with both engineers and people from other disciplines.
Automates operations and organizes source code into functions to improve the program development process and solve generic problems.
Designs and correctly uses arrays and data structures to solve problems through programs.

Communicates, searches, and correctly structures information orally: Delivers a clear and concise oral presentation and project defense, adequately using the aspects outlined in the oral communication guide and information tools.
Develops and structures programs to solve problems using control flow structures, variables, and logical operators.
Uses the appropriate methodology to find solutions to problems and develop projects: Thoroughly examines problems, searches for significant information to address them, and proposes solutions.

Communicates, searches, and correctly structures information in writing: Drafts a clear and concise project report following the criteria established in the project report writing guide and using information tools.
Demonstrates skills for group work and solves problems using the most appropriate tools in each case.

syllabus_topics: Installation and Configuration of the Development Environment
Development of Basic Programs in C Language
Functions and Decomposition of Algorithms and Code

assessment_methods.method: Project/PBL assessment (technical capability, involvement, work done, results, documentation, technical presentation and defense)
